dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, continuous narrowing of the body mass from the mid-dorsal region toward the posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Smooth lateral margins with no significant asymmetrical bulges or indentations visible.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white; high median pixel intensity across the dorsal surface.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: One prominent dark crescent-shaped mark on the mid-right dorsal surface (anatomical left) and a secondary smaller dark speck located more posteriorly.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A single dark, linear/crescent mark is clearly visible on the dorsal surface, posterior to the blowhole.
other_distinctive_markers: A well-defined, dark circular aperture representing the blowhole is visible at the anterior end of the dorsal plane.
